methods.name: 10x Chromium 5' Gene Expression

methods.name: 10x Chromium 5' Immune Profiling Feature Barcoding

methods.name: 10x Chromium Flex (Fixed RNA Profiling)

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Feature Barcoding
methods.summary: Antibody-oligo tags captured on the same gel beads as mRNA, giving surface-protein counts per droplet alongside transcriptomes.

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Gene Expression

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell 3' Solution v1

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell ATAC

methods.name: 10x Chromium Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression

methods.name: 10x Visium
methods.summary: Commercial spatial gene expression assay that captures polyadenylated RNA from tissue sections on barcoded spots on a slide.

methods.name: 10x Visium HD 3' Spatial Gene Expression
methods.aliases: Visium HD 3'; HD 3' Spatial Gene Expression
methods.summary: Poly(A)-based whole-transcriptome spatial gene expression assay on fresh frozen tissue, run with the Visium CytAssist instrument.

methods.name: 10x Xenium In Situ

methods.name: 123FASTQ
methods.title: 123FASTQ: an intuitive and efficient tool for preprocessing Illumina FASTQ reads
methods.summary: Integrates sequencing-read quality control, trimming, and format conversion in a graphical workflow.

methods.name: 16S-FASAS
methods.full_name: 16S full-length amplicon sequencing data analysis software
methods.title: 16S-FASAS: an integrated pipeline for synthetic full-length 16S rRNA gene sequencing data analysis
methods.summary: 16S-FASAS processes synthetic full-length 16S rRNA gene sequencing data for microbiome taxonomic analysis.

methods.name: 2-kupl
methods.title: 2-kupl: mapping-free variant detection from DNA-seq data of matched samples

methods.name: 2bRAD-M
methods.title: Species-resolved sequencing of low-biomass or degraded microbiomes using 2bRAD-M
methods.summary: Sequences a highly reduced fraction of metagenomes to profile microbial species in low-biomass or degraded samples.

methods.name: 2C-RT

methods.summary: Replication timing from EdU-labelled S-phase cells sorted by a cell-cycle marker and DNA content, with multiplexed EdU-seq.

methods.name: 2cChIP-seq

methods.summary: Carrier-assisted ChIP-seq that adds modified-histone mimics and dUTP-containing DNA carriers to recover histone-mark profiles from 10-1000 cells.

methods.name: 2DImpute

methods.name: 2FAST2Q
methods.title: 2FAST2Q: a general-purpose sequence search and counting program for FASTQ files
methods.summary: Extracts and counts specified sequence features in FASTQ reads with filtering and mismatch search options.

methods.name: 3'-seq

methods.name: 3'Pool-seq

methods.summary: Low-cost 3'-end-focused bulk RNA-seq with dual-indexed pooling in 96-well plates and tagmentation.

methods.title: An efficient method for genome-wide polyadenylation site mapping and RNA quantification
methods.summary: Poly(A) stretches are filled in with unlabeled dTTP so sequencing starts right after the tail into the 3'UTR, mapping polyadenylation sites and quantifying RNA.

methods.name: 3AIM-seq
methods.title: 3AIM-seq: Quality assessment of mRNA therapeutics using sequencing for 3' poly(A) tails of in vitro-transcribed mRNA

methods.name: 3C

methods.name: 3D Genome Browser

methods.name: 4Cin

methods.name: 4DMax

methods.name: 4mC-TAB-seq

methods.title: Chromosome Conformation Capture Carbon Copy (5C): a massively parallel solution for mapping interactions between genomic elements

methods.name: 5FU-seq

methods.name: 5PSeq Explorer

ACTIVA

methods.name: xseq
methods.title: Systematic analysis of somatic mutations impacting gene expression in 12 tumour types
methods.summary: Hierarchical Bayes model that quantifies the impact of somatic mutations on expression profiles, applied to TCGA tumour data sets.

methods.name: xTea
methods.title: Comprehensive identification of transposable element insertions using multiple sequencing technologies
methods.summary: Tool that identifies transposable element insertions from short-read and long-read whole-genome sequencing data.

methods.name: XTree
methods.title: XTree enables memory-efficient, accurate short and long sequence alignment to millions of genomes across the tree of life
methods.summary: Aligns short and long sequencing reads to large whole-genome reference databases.

methods.name: XVir
methods.title: XVir: A Transformer-Based Architecture for Identifying Viral Reads from Cancer Samples
methods.summary: Transformer-based pipeline that identifies viral DNA in human tumor sequencing reads.

methods.name: xxChIP-seq
methods.title: Linker histone epitopes are hidden by in situ higher-order chromatin structure
methods.summary: xxChIP-seq binds antibodies to fixed intact chromatin before a second fixation and immunoprecipitation to map exposed chromatin epitopes.

methods.name: XYZeq
methods.title: XYZeq: Spatially resolved single-cell RNA sequencing reveals expression heterogeneity in the tumor microenvironment
methods.summary: Spatially barcoded single-cell RNA-seq workflow that encodes tissue-position metadata into scRNA-seq libraries.

methods.name: Y-LineageTracker
methods.title: Y-LineageTracker: a high-throughput analysis framework for Y-chromosomal next-generation sequencing data
methods.summary: Framework for Y-chromosome haplogroup assignment, Y-STR analysis and paternal lineage inference from NGS data.

methods.name: Y2H-SCORES
methods.title: Y2H-SCORES: A statistical framework to infer protein-protein interactions from next-generation yeast-two-hybrid sequence data
methods.summary: Statistical framework that ranks candidate protein interaction partners from high-throughput yeast two-hybrid sequencing screens.

methods.name: Y2H-seq
methods.title: A Y2H-seq approach defines the human protein methyltransferase interactome
methods.summary: Yeast two-hybrid interaction screening read out by short-read sequencing with a quantitative scoring readout, used to map the human protein methyltransferase interactome.

methods.name: YaHS
methods.title: YaHS: yet another Hi-C scaffolding tool
methods.summary: Command-line Hi-C scaffolding tool that builds chromosome-scale scaffolds from an assembly and an alignment file.

methods.name: YAMAT-seq
methods.title: YAMAT-seq: an efficient method for high-throughput sequencing of mature transfer RNAs
methods.summary: Y-shaped adapter ligation with T4 RNA ligase 2 to mature tRNAs, then cDNA amplification, for efficient high-throughput tRNA sequencing.

methods.name: YClon
methods.title: Yclon: Ultrafast clustering of B cell clones from high-throughput immunoglobulin repertoire sequencing data
methods.summary: A hierarchical clustering method groups immunoglobulin repertoire sequences into B cell clones.

methods.name: yeastDrop-Seq
methods.title: A yeast-optimized single-cell transcriptomics platform elucidates how mycophenolic acid and guanine alter global mRNA levels
methods.summary: Drop-seq variant optimised for yeast cells to count mRNA molecules per individual cell.

methods.name: YETI
methods.title: Interpretation of an individual functional genomics experiment guided by massive public data
methods.summary: Builds tailored functional interaction maps from public functional genomics data to interpret an individual omics experiment.

methods.name: YMAP
methods.title: YMAP: a pipeline for visualization of copy number variation and loss of heterozygosity in eukaryotic pathogens
methods.summary: Analyzes and visualizes genome-wide copy number variation, single nucleotide polymorphisms and loss of heterozygosity in pathogen datasets.

methods.name: Yruler
methods.title: Measuring satellite arrays of the human Y chromosome from sequencing reads
methods.summary: Alignment-free method that uses pangenome assemblies and sequencing reads to estimate human Y chromosome satellite array properties.

methods.name: yscRNA-seq
methods.title: Sensitive high-throughput single-cell RNA-seq reveals within-clonal transcript correlations in yeast populations
methods.summary: Strand-specific single-cell RNA-seq for yeast that counts transcript start sites, paired with index sorting to relate RNA content to cell size.

methods.name: ZARP
methods.title: ZARP: An automated workflow for processing of RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Provides a general-purpose automated workflow for processing and analyzing RNA-seq datasets.

methods.name: ZCNT
methods.title: A zero-agnostic model for copy number evolution in cancer
methods.summary: Copy-number phylogeny model that allows amplification or deletion of regions with zero copies, with a closed-form distance.

methods.name: ZEN
methods.title: Zone equalisation normalisation for improved alignment of epigenetic signal
methods.summary: Normalisation that rescales genomic signal by variance within enriched regions to align replicates and samples.

methods.name: ZetaSuite
methods.title: ZetaSuite: computational analysis of two-dimensional high-throughput data from multi-target screens and single-cell transcriptomics
methods.summary: Applies Zeta statistics to analyze two-dimensional high-throughput functional screens and single-cell transcriptomics data.

methods.name: ZINB-WaVE
methods.title: A general and flexible method for signal extraction from single-cell RNA-seq data
methods.summary: Zero-inflated negative binomial model giving low-dimensional scRNA-seq representations that account for dropouts and batch effects.

methods.name: zingeR
methods.title: zingeR: unlocking RNA-seq tools for zero-inflation and single cell applications
methods.summary: Observation-weight method that makes bulk RNA-seq differential expression tools robust to zero inflation in single-cell data.

methods.name: ZipSeq
methods.title: ZipSeq: barcoding for real-time mapping of single cell transcriptomes
methods.summary: Patterned illumination prints photocaged barcodes ("zipcodes") onto live cells in tissue, linking each transcriptome to its position.

methods.name: Zman-seq
methods.title: Time-resolved single-cell transcriptomics defines immune trajectories in glioblastoma
methods.summary: Single-cell transcriptomics with time stamps written into circulating immune cells, so their state changes can be tracked in tissue over days.

methods.name: ZymoR
methods.title: ZymoR: Bridging plant pathology and automated bioinformatics for fungicide resistance profiling in Zymoseptoria tritici
methods.summary: Automated bioinformatics platform for detecting fungicide-resistance mutations and CYP51 haplotypes in Zymoseptoria tritici high-throughput sequencing data.

methods.name: μ-cisTarget
methods.title: Identification of cis-regulatory mutations generating de novo edges in personalized cancer gene regulatory networks
methods.summary: Filters, annotates and prioritises cis-regulatory mutations by their predicted effect on a personal gene regulatory network.

methods.name: μChIP-seq (Dahl 2016)
methods.title: Broad histone H3K4me3 domains in mouse oocytes modulate maternal-to-zygotic transition
methods.summary: Micro-scale ChIP-seq that profiles histone H3 lysine methylation and acetylation from very few cells, used on mouse oocytes and early embryos.

methods.name: π-FISH+
methods.title: Highly efficient and robust π-FISH rainbow for multiplexed in situ detection of diverse biomolecules
methods.summary: Combines multiplex π-FISH with hybridization chain reaction to detect short nucleic acid fragments in situ.
